theorems.statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (S : Set (Euclid (m + 1))) (u : Euclid (m + 1) → ℝ), volume S = 1 → IntegrableOn u S → ∫ x in S, |u x - ∫ y in S, u y| ≤ ∫ x in S, ∫ y in S, |u x - u y|
